description: FICTIONAL forensic-incident fixture (NOT real plant data; no real company/site). Northgate Specialty Chemicals R-101 cooling-water surge tank TK-110: a mid-batch LIT-110 sensor spoof freezes the level while the meters show a sustained jacket draw, breaking the mass_tank_volume closure.

balance.definition: residual = dLIT-110 - (FIT-110A - FIT-110B); ~0 under normal control, jumps to the net-draw magnitude when the spoofed level contradicts the metered flow.

fault.mode: LIT-110 sensor spoof (frozen level) while meters show net jacket draw
